address: 27975 Old 41 Rd., Bonita Springs, FL, 34135, USA
bio: Monday could be Friday, and Saturday could be Tuesday at this colorful hotspot in Bonita Springs. Dark, moody lighting and striking teal walls adorned with eclectic art set the tone as crowds file in throughout the week looking for a proper good time. The menu roams the globe and takes much of its inspiration from Asia: A deconstructed banh mi features smoked short rib, and serious steaks come with Japanese sweet potatoes. Everything is designed to be shared, so bring friends.
